backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a logo replacement request and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summaries of major frontend source files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styles including dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts and mounting the React app.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots configuration allowing all crawlers and linking to sitemap.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing main site routes with priority and change frequency.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for all site pages using SiteLayout.
Renders call and WhatsApp CTA buttons with size variants.
frontend/src/components/cta/whatsapp.ts: Generates encoded WhatsApp deep links for general and enquiry messages.
frontend/src/components/forms/EnquiryFor: Full enquiry form with validation, success screen, and WhatsApp submission link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer with company info, navigation links, contact details, social icons, and old logo reference.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive header with logo, navigation links, contact buttons, and a mobile slide-out menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Wraps the site with a header, footer, and main content outlet.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Catego: Displays a grid of product categories with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Segmen: Renders a grid of business segments served, each with an icon and description.
frontend/src/components/marketing/StepsT: Shows a multi-step process timeline with separate desktop and mobile layouts.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TrustB: Shows trust badges with images, titles, and short descriptions.
frontend/src/components/seo/Seo.tsx: Updates document title and meta description using React effects.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining the brand’s color theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React, query client, identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with SEO metadata, company overview, and feature cards highlighting cost reduction, freshness, farmer support, and supply reliability.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact information, enquiry form, and communication options including phone, WhatsApp, email, and address details.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the homepage with a hero section, warehouse image, trust badges, and key feature cards promoting delivery, quality, and pricing.
frontend/src/pages/HowItWorksPage.tsx: Explains the company’s 4‑step supply process using a timeline and provides ordering instructions with CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Shows product categories via a grid, describes business suitability, and includes CTAs for custom bulk quotes.
frontend/src/pages/WhoWeServePage.tsx: Outlines business segments served using a segment grid and highlights service reliability for various sectors.
frontend/src/pages/WhyChooseUsPage.tsx: Lists reasons to choose the company using icon cards and emphasizes pricing, freshness, logistics, and farmer support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for a B2B website build, including design requirements, known issues, and existing implemented features.
